about: A fast Python HTTP client built on the Rust reqwest library.

prs.title: File uploads work through the sync httpx transport
prs.broken: Any file upload through the library's sync httpx transport failed before sending, with an error saying the stream was async.
prs.changed: I made the check reject only streams that cannot be read in sync code, since httpx's upload stream supports both.
prs.matters: Apps using httpx with this faster transport can upload files again.
